name: Driving / Racing
description: The pure circuit racer: launch, corner, drift, overtake, place. This pack is the shared foundation for every vehicle genre in the squad — VehicleTuning defines how a car feels, TrackCircuit defines what progress means, and DriftScoring, RubberBandAI, and GhostReplay turn a solo time trial into a contest against the pack, the clock, and your own best self. The design stance: handling is data, a lap is a contract enforced by gates, and every assist (rubber band, ghost) operates inside the same physics the player drives, never around it.

signatureCompound.name: Lap Attack
signatureCompound.description: The smallest race that proves the genre: track_circuit validates gates and laps on timer_system's clock, vehicle_tuning gives each car its feel, rubber_band_ai keeps AI rivals in the fight by pace-scaling through the same tuning path, drift_scoring banks style points at checkpoints, and ghost_replay records the whole thing against the race clock so the next attempt races the last one. world.raceFinished is both the result and the save trigger.
